tweets.text:
The way people access global markets is changing pretty quickly.

As more trading moves onchain, I think the platforms building around that shift are worth watching.

What does the next generation of global market access actually look like?

It’s interesting to see RWAPerp becoming part of that conversation.

The platform is built as a 24/7 onchain gateway for stocks, commodities, indices and crypto.

RWAperp announced $200M in cumulative perp volume. I pulled up DefiLlama, and it’s already past $300M.

Trading days lately have averaged around $20M, and daily volume still peaked on Oct 20, when it topped $80M.

For me, the interesting part isn’t just the numbers. It’s seeing how the platform is evolving around the actual trading experience.

What kind of platforms are you following?
